sources.title: Hy-MT2-7B official model card
sources.evidence: Identifies the exact 7B translation model, Hy-MT2 family, text translation instructions, nominal 7B model size, and explicitly announces open-sourcing the 7B checkpoint on 2026-05-21. The paper/card call the family fast-thinking; no native tool-calling or separate reasoning-mode capability is specified.

sources.title: Hy-MT2 official release and deployment README
sources.evidence: Lists Hy-MT2-7B and the 2026-05-21 open-weight release. Inference and Deployment explicitly says max_context: 8192, followed by inference guidance for 1.8B and 7B.

sources.title: Hy-MT2-7B checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: HunYuanDenseV1ForCausalLM / hunyuan_v1_dense; 32 layers, width 4096, MLP width 14336, 32 query heads and 8 KV heads, head dimension 128, RMS/QK normalization, BF16, no attention/MLP biases or quantization config. max_position_embeddings is 262144 and tie_word_embeddings is true.

sources.title: Hy-MT2-7B license
sources.evidence: The license text explicitly identifies Hy-MT2-7B as licensed under Apache License Version 2.0.

sources.title: Hy-MT2: A Family of Fast, Efficient and Powerful Multilingual Translation Models in the Wild
sources.evidence: First-party report identifies the 7B member of the translation family, covers dense and MoE models, describes translation-specific post-training and evaluates the 7B model. Its fast-thinking description and benchmark notation do not explicitly establish a separate reasoning mode or native tools.

sources.title: Hy-MT2 official model training guide
sources.evidence: Explicitly labels Hy-MT2-7B Dense. Training max_seq_length 8192 and configurable fine-tuning cutoff lengths are distinct from the inference context specification.

sources.title: Hy-MT2-7B safetensors index
sources.evidence: Indexes 355 tensor names in four shards and reports total_parameters 8029540352 and total_size 16059080704. Both model.embed_tokens.weight and lm_head.weight are separately present despite the configured weight tie. This metadata total is not accepted as an independent unique-parameter total.

sources.title: Transformers 5.6.0 HunYuanDenseV1 implementation
sources.evidence: The implementation recommended by Tencent defines a causal dense Transformer, gated SiLU MLPs, grouped-query attention, QK RMSNorm, and a tied lm_head.weight -> model.embed_tokens.weight mapping. RoPE inverse-frequency tensors are nonpersistent buffers. All 355 serialized shapes match configured learned modules, but the two serialized embedding payloads were not downloaded to establish whether they are identical.

sources.title: Hy-MT2-7B shard 1 safetensors header
sources.evidence: Fetched only the 8-byte size prefix and bounded JSON header with HTTP 206, never the weight payload. Together all four headers exactly cover all 355 indexed BF16 tensors, with 8029540352 stored elements; no packed tensors, quantization scales or serialized buffers occur.

sources.title: Hy-MT2-7B released chat template
sources.evidence: Simple system/user/assistant text framing using startoftext, extra_0, extra_4 and eos. No tools schema, function-call serialization or reasoning/thinking switch is implemented; this absence alone does not prove inability.

sources.title: Hy-MT2-7B tokenizer configuration
sources.evidence: Text tokenizer and matching chat template; model_max_length 262144 is a configuration ceiling. No named thinking/reasoning/tool special tokens were found. Neither this ceiling nor token/template inspection overrides explicit deployment documentation.

sources.title: Tencent reply on Hy-MT2-7B context length
sources.evidence: In a discussion of the official 7B GGUF release, the Tencent organization member states on May 27 that the model supports a maximum context of 8K and acknowledges quality degradation with long texts; corroborates the shared README maximum.

sources.title: Hy-MT2 technical report, revised May 25, 2026
sources.evidence: Reopened the complete latest v2 report on October 27; the arXiv revision history still ends at May 25 v2. Abstract and experimental model labels retain nominal 7B. Sections 2.1-2.2 describe an unspecified Hy-series pretraining model, mid-training and distillation; Hy3-Preview is a teacher, not an identified unchanged 7B base. No active-parameter count or active-count comparison column is supplied for the 7B student. The prior reasoning/tool-capability finding is unchanged.

sources.title: Current Tencent Hy-MT2-7B model card, parameter re-audit
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 current card matches the pinned card: the introduction specifies model sizes 1.8B, 7B and 30B-A3B, and Model Links identifies the exact checkpoint as the Hy 7B translation model. No separate active count is stated for 7B.

sources.title: Current Hy-MT2 release README, parameter re-audit
sources.evidence: Fresh current release README again identifies the exact Hy-MT2-7B nominal model size. The separate 30B-A3B MoE sibling and low-bit variants do not supply a 7B active-count convention.

sources.title: Current Hy-MT2 training guide, parameter re-audit
sources.evidence: Fresh guide explicitly labels Hy-MT2-7B Dense and names full and LoRA fine-tuning recipes. It gives no separately defined inference active-parameter count.

sources.title: FlexAI Hy-MT2 7B deployment catalog: insufficient active-count lead
sources.evidence: The provider lists exact weights tencent/Hy-MT2-7B and active parameters 8B of 8.02954B. No original measurement, benchmark or counting methodology accompanies the value. The displayed total matches rounded serialized-element metadata, which includes two embedding matrices despite configured tying; rounding that storage total would yield 8B. This is an unvalidated catalog claim, not an original model/research-team active-count convention.

sources.title: Full-Video Context and Anonymous Candidate Selection for WMT26 Video Subtitle Translation
sources.evidence: Original October 2026 system paper identifies tencent/Hy-MT2-7B and unchanged Gemma-4-12B-it. Abstract and Section 4.3 describe approximately 19B unique weights for the combined system and Section 4.2 gives 28B if Qwen3.5-9B is added. These are nominal ensemble-budget totals, not an active count for Hy-MT2-7B. Complete text contains no explicit active-parameter convention.

sources.title: HW-TSC submission to the WMT 2026 General Machine Translation Track
sources.publisher: Huawei Translation Service Center; ACL Anthology
sources.evidence: Original October 2026 Huawei system research uses HY-MT2-7B for candidate generation alongside fine-tuned openPangu-Embedded-7B and DeepSeek-V4-Flash. Its method and result comparisons do not give an active-parameter column or count for the Tencent model.

sources.title: SubVision at WMT26: QLoRA Fine-Tuning of Hy-MT2-1.8B for Chinese to English Video Subtitle Translation
sources.publisher: Prajwal Ghimire and Aashish Mahato; ACL Anthology
sources.evidence: Original October 2026 study explicitly compares the exact tencent/Hy-MT2-7B in Section 6.5 and Table 6. It supplies no inference active count for that baseline. The trainable/total parameter numbers in Table 1 describe the separate 1.8B QLoRA setup, so they cannot establish the target 7B count.

name.note: Exact developer spelling and size suffix; unchanged.

developer.note: Tencent is the copyright holder, publisher and named developer team.

family.note: The explicitly named family is Hy-MT2; normalized to the catalog lowercase family convention rather than generic Hy.

release_date.note: The release news explicitly says the exact 7B checkpoint was open-sourced on this date. Repository creation on May 11 and later provider listings are not release evidence.

open_weights.note: The exact checkpoint is publicly distributed in four accessible safetensors shards; bounded header fetches verified access without downloading weights.

license.note: The exact checkpoint license explicitly names Apache License Version 2.0.

parameters_b.note: 7B is Tencent's nominal model-size label, not an exact count. All four indexed headers cover 355 BF16 tensors and sum to 8,029,540,352 stored elements. This includes two 524,972,032-element input/output matrices, while config and Transformers declare them tied. Honoring that tie gives 7,504,568,320 unique configured parameters; equality of the separately serialized matrices is not established from headers. All module shapes reconcile, no quantization tensors occur, and RoPE buffers are nonpersistent. Retain the author nominal count rather than mislabeling the storage sum as exact unique parameters. Fresh current card, release README and latest v2 report reconfirm the nominal 7B size; the pinned index still reports the same storage total. The later ensemble-budget paper is consistent with nominal size but is not a new exact census.

active_parameters_b.note: No supported active count was found in the reopened Tencent sources or later original WMT comparisons. The report names only an unspecified Hy-series pretraining base and a Hy3-Preview teacher, so their active counts cannot be inherited by the 7B student. FlexAI lists 8B active without a measurement or counting method; its 8.02954B total matches serialized storage with unresolved duplicated-versus-tied embeddings. Neither that listing nor dense architecture establishes an active count. Retain null.

architecture.note: The developer explicitly labels 7B Dense. The configuration and implementation show a 32-layer causal decoder-only Transformer with GQA, gated SiLU MLPs, RMSNorm and QK normalization; not the 30B-A3B MoE sibling.

context_window.note: The deployment README explicitly states max_context 8192; a Tencent member confirms 8K for the exact 7B GGUF model. The 262144 model/tokenizer configuration ceiling is not promoted to a supported inference context window.

modalities.note: The exact checkpoint is a text tokenizer plus causal language model for text-to-text translation; no audio/image input or output module is present.

reasoning.note: Tencent describes fast-thinking translation and evaluates unmarked 7B rows separately from thinking-mode baselines, but does not explicitly state that this checkpoint supports or forbids a distinct reasoning mode. The released template has no thinking switch. This is insufficient to verify the baseline false capability assertion; clear it.

tool_call.note: No first-party tool-calling capability statement or native tool protocol is documented for this exact checkpoint. A translation integration skill is not evidence of model-native function calling, and the simple chat template alone cannot prove unsupported functionality. Clear the baseline false assertion.

patch.description: Tencent multilingual translation model using a dense decoder-only Transformer, with instructions for terminology, style, contextual translation and structured text.
patch.notes: 7B is Tencent's nominal size. The 8.029540352B stored-element sum includes separately serialized input/output embeddings despite configured tying; 7.50456832B is the configured unique count if tied, with payload equality unverified. Active parameters remain undisclosed. Supported inference context is 8192; the 262144 configuration ceiling is not a validated context claim. Native reasoning-mode and tool-calling support remain unverified.

summary: Parameter re-audit retains Tencent's nominal 7B total with primary provenance and leaves active parameters undisclosed. Fresh developer sources and three later original WMT studies supply no supported active count; the FlexAI 8B active listing has no counting methodology and matches rounded storage metadata. Preserve the prior complete 355-tensor census and its unresolved separately serialized versus configured-tied embeddings, plus all 12 non-parameter assessments.

parameter_reaudit.outcome: Retain verified developer-nominal total 7B; active count remains undisclosed after fresh first-party, lineage and later original-research searches.
parameter_reaudit.search_findings: Current Tencent card/release/training documentation and complete latest v2 paper retain nominal 7B without an active convention. Generic pretraining-family lineage and a separately named distillation teacher do not supply one. Original October WMT papers 207, 66 and 203 identify this model but report ensemble budget, performance or a different QLoRA model rather than its active parameters. FlexAI is only an unsupported catalog lead.
parameter_reaudit.remaining_uncertainty: Exact unique learned checkpoint total remains conditional on the configured embedding tie because the separately serialized matrices were not compared. No supported original active-parameter counting convention was found.
parameter_reaudit.access_limitations: Web reader could not open the WMT PDFs; direct original ACL downloads succeeded with HTTP 200 and full text was extracted locally.
